structure.unit: General Provisions; Charters; Other Forms and Organization of Counties
Urban County Executive Form of Government

law.catch_line: Designation of officer or employee to exercise power or perform duty
law.text: Whenever it is not designated herein what officer or employee of the county shall exercise any power or perform any duty conferred upon or required of the county, or any officer thereof, by general law, then any such power shall be exercised or duty performed by that officer or employee of the county so designated by ordinance or resolution of the board.
